user.title: SparkSync
user.description: What is publishing to your broker?

gateway.description: Generators publish one telemetry section per topic under devices/<id>/. Each gateway is discovered from its own topics.

data_description.websocket: Turn off to connect straight to a broker's IP or hostname over TCP (e.g. the Mosquitto add-on on port 1883, TLS off).
data_description.base_topic: The device id and section are appended: devices/esp32-<mac>/generator

meter.description: Meter nodes publish a whole reading every 5 seconds. Nodes are discovered from their topics.

data_description.websocket: Turn off to connect straight to a broker's IP or hostname over TCP (e.g. the Mosquitto add-on on port 1883, TLS off).
data_description.base_topic: The node MAC is appended: SparkSync/Meter/<mac>

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the broker

abort.already_configured: That broker and base topic are already configured
